explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/441: Chen–Dai proved g(N) ≤ (9N/8)^{1/2} + O((N/log N)^{1/2} log log N). The statement asserts g - √(9N/8) = O(√(N/log N)·log log N), a two-sided bound. That is still true, since the matching lower bound g ≥ √(9N/8) - O(1) from Erdős's construction is dominated by the error term. Faithful.
